```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

**Purpose:**
To give functional annotations to the 'top' expressed cytokines (those that had all samples higher than the LLoQ). Then see which functions are highly represented, without any statistical comparison, all descriptive.

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(httr); library(jsonlite); library(ggplot2)})

# ---- 0. paths -------------------------------------------------------------
in_csv  <- "csdh_heatmap_data.csv"          # input (this folder)
out_top <- "top_analytes.csv"               # the 5/5-QUANT set + genes
out_pw  <- "pathway_counts_reactome.csv"    # ranked pathway table
out_fig <- "pathway_classification"         # figure basename (.png / .pdf)

# ---- 1. read data ---------------------------------------------------------
df <- read.csv(in_csv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# ---- 2. analyte -> HGNC gene symbol (one representative symbol each) -------
gene_map <- c(
  "EGF"="EGF","FGF-2"="FGF2","PDGF-AA"="PDGFA","PDGF-AB/BB"="PDGFB","TGFa"="TGFA","VEGF-A"="VEGFA",
  "MMP-2"="MMP2","MMP-9"="MMP9",
  "Eotaxin"="CCL11","Fractalkine"="CX3CL1","GROa"="CXCL1","IL-8"="CXCL8","IP-10"="CXCL10",
  "MCP-1"="CCL2","MCP-3"="CCL7","MDC"="CCL22","MIG"="CXCL9","MIP-1a"="CCL3","MIP-1b"="CCL4",
  "IFNa2"="IFNA2","IFNy"="IFNG","IL-1a"="IL1A","IL-1b"="IL1B","IL-2"="IL2","IL-3"="IL3","IL-6"="IL6",
  "IL-12p40"="IL12B","IL-12p70"="IL12A","IL-15"="IL15","IL-17A"="IL17A","IL-17E/IL-25"="IL25",
  "IL-17F"="IL17F","IL-18"="IL18","TNFa"="TNF","TNFb"="LTA",
  "IL-1RA"="IL1RN","IL-4"="IL4","IL-5"="IL5","IL-9"="IL9","IL-10"="IL10","IL-13"="IL13",
  "IL-22"="IL22","IL-27"="IL27",
  "sCD40L"="CD40LG","FLT-3L"="FLT3LG","G-CSF"="CSF3","GM-CSF"="CSF2","IL-7"="IL7","M-CSF"="CSF1")

# ---- 3. derive the 'top' set: QUANT in every patient ----------------------
n_pat <- length(unique(df$patient))
agg <- aggregate(status ~ analyte + category, data = df,
                 FUN = function(s) sum(s == "QUANT"))
names(agg)[names(agg) == "status"] <- "n_quant"
agg$n_pat <- n_pat
top <- agg[agg$n_quant == n_pat, ]
top$gene <- gene_map[top$analyte]

if (any(is.na(top$gene)))
  stop("Unmapped analyte(s): ", paste(top$analyte[is.na(top$gene)], collapse = ", "))

top <- top[order(top$analyte), c("analyte","gene","category","n_quant","n_pat")]
write.csv(top, out_top, row.names = FALSE)
genes <- unique(top$gene)
cat(sprintf("Top set (QUANT in all %d patients): %d analytes\n", n_pat, nrow(top)))
cat(paste(genes, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")

# ---- 4. query Reactome: pathways containing these genes -------------------
# AnalysisService returns every pathway that contains >=1 submitted gene,
# with entities$found (count) and entities$total (pathway size).
url <- paste0("https://reactome.org/AnalysisService/identifiers/projection",
              "?interactors=false&pageSize=500&page=1",
              "&sortBy=ENTITIES_FOUND&order=DESC&resource=TOTAL&includeDisease=true")

resp <- POST(url,
             body = paste(genes, collapse = "\n"),
             content_type("text/plain"),
             accept_json(),
             timeout(90))
stop_for_status(resp)
res <- fromJSON(content(resp, "text", encoding = "UTF-8"), flatten = TRUE)

pw <- res$pathways
if (is.null(pw) || length(pw) == 0) stop("Reactome returned no pathways.")

# ---- 5. build ranked table with the ratio column --------------------------
out <- data.frame(
  pathway_name = pw$name,
  reactome_id  = pw$stId,
  n_genes      = pw$entities.found,
  size         = pw$entities.total,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
out$ratio <- round(out$n_genes / out$size, 4)

# primary ranking = raw count; ties broken by specificity ratio
out <- out[order(-out$n_genes, -out$ratio), ]
rownames(out) <- NULL

not_found <- if (!is.null(res$identifiersNotFound)) res$identifiersNotFound else NA
cat(sprintf("Genes submitted: %d   not mapped by Reactome: %s\n",
            length(genes), as.character(not_found)))
cat(sprintf("Pathways containing >=1 top gene: %d\n\n", nrow(out)))

cat("=== Top 25 pathways by number of top-expressed genes ===\n")
print(head(out[, c("n_genes","size","ratio","pathway_name")], 25), row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(out, out_pw, row.names = FALSE)

# ---- 6. figure: top 10 pathways by specificity ratio ----------------------
# Bar length = ratio (fraction of the pathway made up of your top cytokines).
# Both requested numbers appear on each bar: the ratio and the cytokine count
# (n / size), and the count is also encoded by fill colour.
top10 <- head(out[order(-out$ratio, -out$n_genes), ], 10)
wrap  <- function(x, w = 40) sapply(x, function(s) paste(strwrap(s, w), collapse = "\n"))
top10$label_y <- factor(wrap(top10$pathway_name),
                        levels = rev(wrap(top10$pathway_name)))   # keep rank order
top10$bar_lab <- sprintf("ratio %.2f  (%d/%d)", top10$ratio, top10$n_genes, top10$size)

p <- ggplot(top10, aes(x = ratio, y = label_y, fill = n_genes)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72) +
  geom_text(aes(label = bar_lab), hjust = -0.05, size = 3.2) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#FBCEB1", high = "#EC5800", name = "cytokines\nin pathway") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.28))) +
  labs(title = "cSDH top-expressed cytokines: pathway classification",
       subtitle = sprintf("Top 10 Reactome pathways by specificity ratio (n genes / pathway size); %d/%d-QUANT analytes",
                          n_pat, n_pat),
       x = "Cytokine ratio (cytokines in pathway/total pathway size)", y = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

ggsave(paste0(out_fig, ".png"), p, width = 9.5, height = 5.5, dpi = 300)
ggsave(paste0(out_fig, ".pdf"), p, width = 9.5, height = 5.5)

cat(sprintf("\nWritten: %s  (full ranked table)\n         %s  (top set + gene map)\n         %s.png / .pdf  (figure)\n",
            out_pw, out_top, out_fig))

p
```

Same, but for GO BP:
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(org.Hs.eg.db); library(GO.db); library(AnnotationDbi); library(ggplot2)
})

# ---- 0. paths -------------------------------------------------------------
in_csv  <- "csdh_heatmap_data.csv"          # input (this folder)
out_top <- "top_analytes.csv"               # the 5/5-QUANT set + genes
out_pw  <- "gobp_counts.csv"                # ranked GO:BP table
out_fig <- "gobp_classification"            # figure basename (.png / .pdf)
min_size_fig <- 10                          # min term size shown in the figure
                                            # (GO has many tiny leaf terms that
                                            #  would otherwise dominate a ratio
                                            #  ranking; set to 0 to disable)

# ---- 1. read data ---------------------------------------------------------
df <- read.csv(in_csv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# ---- 2. analyte -> HGNC gene symbol (one representative symbol each) -------
gene_map <- c(
  "EGF"="EGF","FGF-2"="FGF2","PDGF-AA"="PDGFA","PDGF-AB/BB"="PDGFB","TGFa"="TGFA","VEGF-A"="VEGFA",
  "MMP-2"="MMP2","MMP-9"="MMP9",
  "Eotaxin"="CCL11","Fractalkine"="CX3CL1","GROa"="CXCL1","IL-8"="CXCL8","IP-10"="CXCL10",
  "MCP-1"="CCL2","MCP-3"="CCL7","MDC"="CCL22","MIG"="CXCL9","MIP-1a"="CCL3","MIP-1b"="CCL4",
  "IFNa2"="IFNA2","IFNy"="IFNG","IL-1a"="IL1A","IL-1b"="IL1B","IL-2"="IL2","IL-3"="IL3","IL-6"="IL6",
  "IL-12p40"="IL12B","IL-12p70"="IL12A","IL-15"="IL15","IL-17A"="IL17A","IL-17E/IL-25"="IL25",
  "IL-17F"="IL17F","IL-18"="IL18","TNFa"="TNF","TNFb"="LTA",
  "IL-1RA"="IL1RN","IL-4"="IL4","IL-5"="IL5","IL-9"="IL9","IL-10"="IL10","IL-13"="IL13",
  "IL-22"="IL22","IL-27"="IL27",
  "sCD40L"="CD40LG","FLT-3L"="FLT3LG","G-CSF"="CSF3","GM-CSF"="CSF2","IL-7"="IL7","M-CSF"="CSF1")

# ---- 3. derive the 'top' set: QUANT in every patient ----------------------
n_pat <- length(unique(df$patient))
agg <- aggregate(status ~ analyte + category, data = df,
                 FUN = function(s) sum(s == "QUANT"))
names(agg)[names(agg) == "status"] <- "n_quant"
agg$n_pat <- n_pat
top <- agg[agg$n_quant == n_pat, ]
top$gene <- gene_map[top$analyte]
if (any(is.na(top$gene)))
  stop("Unmapped analyte(s): ", paste(top$analyte[is.na(top$gene)], collapse = ", "))
top <- top[order(top$analyte), c("analyte","gene","category","n_quant","n_pat")]
write.csv(top, out_top, row.names = FALSE)
genes <- unique(top$gene)
cat(sprintf("Top set (QUANT in all %d patients): %d analytes\n", n_pat, nrow(top)))
cat(paste(genes, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")

# ---- 4. map symbols -> Entrez, then count genes per GO:BP term ------------
eg <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = genes, column = "ENTREZID",
                            keytype = "SYMBOL", multiVals = "first")
not_found <- names(eg)[is.na(eg)]
Q <- unique(as.character(eg[!is.na(eg)]))    # query Entrez IDs

# GO term -> all annotated human Entrez genes (annotations propagated up the
# hierarchy; this is the standard 'gene set' definition used for GO analysis)
go2eg <- AnnotationDbi::as.list(org.Hs.egGO2ALLEGS)
go2eg <- lapply(go2eg, function(x) unique(as.character(x)))

# keep Biological Process terms only
onto <- suppressMessages(AnnotationDbi::select(
  GO.db, keys = names(go2eg), columns = c("ONTOLOGY","TERM"), keytype = "GOID"))
onto <- onto[!duplicated(onto$GOID), ]
bp_ids <- onto$GOID[onto$ONTOLOGY == "BP"]
go2eg <- go2eg[names(go2eg) %in% bp_ids]

# ---- 5. build ranked table with the ratio column --------------------------
n_genes <- vapply(go2eg, function(g) length(intersect(g, Q)), integer(1))
size    <- vapply(go2eg, length, integer(1))
keep    <- n_genes >= 1

out <- data.frame(
  go_id   = names(go2eg)[keep],
  term    = onto$TERM[match(names(go2eg)[keep], onto$GOID)],
  n_genes = n_genes[keep],
  size    = size[keep],
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
out$ratio <- round(out$n_genes / out$size, 4)

# primary ranking = raw count; ties broken by specificity ratio
out <- out[order(-out$n_genes, -out$ratio), ]
rownames(out) <- NULL

cat(sprintf("Genes submitted: %d   not mapped to Entrez: %s\n",
            length(genes),
            if (length(not_found)) paste(not_found, collapse = ", ") else "0"))
cat(sprintf("GO:BP terms containing >=1 top gene: %d\n\n", nrow(out)))

cat("=== Top 25 GO:BP terms by number of top-expressed genes ===\n")
print(head(out[, c("n_genes","size","ratio","term")], 25), row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(out, out_pw, row.names = FALSE)

# ---- 6. figure: top 10 GO:BP terms by specificity ratio -------------------
# Bar length = ratio; text prints ratio and the raw count (n / size); the count
# is also encoded by fill colour. Terms below min_size_fig are excluded so the
# ratio ranking is not swamped by tiny leaf terms.
fig <- out[out$size >= min_size_fig, ]
top10 <- head(fig[order(-fig$ratio, -fig$n_genes), ], 10)
wrap  <- function(x, w = 40) sapply(x, function(s) paste(strwrap(s, w), collapse = "\n"))
top10$label_y <- factor(wrap(top10$term),
                        levels = rev(wrap(top10$term)))   # keep rank order
top10$bar_lab <- sprintf("ratio %.2f  (%d/%d)", top10$ratio, top10$n_genes, top10$size)

p <- ggplot(top10, aes(x = ratio, y = label_y, fill = n_genes)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72) +
  geom_text(aes(label = bar_lab), hjust = -0.05, size = 3.2) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#FBCEB1", high = "#EC5800", name = "cytokines\nin term") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.28))) +
  labs(title = "cSDH top-expressed cytokines: GO Biological Process classification",
       subtitle = sprintf("Top 10 GO:BP terms by specificity ratio (n genes / term size, size >= %d); %d/%d-QUANT analytes",
                          min_size_fig, n_pat, n_pat),
       x = "Cytokine ratio (cytokines in term/total term size)", y = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

ggsave(paste0(out_fig, ".png"), p, width = 9.5, height = 5.5, dpi = 300)
ggsave(paste0(out_fig, ".pdf"), p, width = 9.5, height = 5.5)

cat(sprintf("\nWritten: %s  (full ranked table)\n         %s  (top set + gene map)\n         %s.png / .pdf  (figure)\n",
            out_pw, out_top, out_fig))
p
```

Try Hallmark next:
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(msigdbr); library(ggplot2)})

# ---- 0. paths -------------------------------------------------------------
in_csv  <- "csdh_heatmap_data.csv"          # input (this folder)
out_top <- "top_analytes.csv"               # the 5/5-QUANT set + genes
out_pw  <- "hallmark_counts.csv"            # ranked Hallmark table
out_fig <- "hallmark_classification"        # figure basename (.png / .pdf)

# ---- 1. read data ---------------------------------------------------------
df <- read.csv(in_csv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# ---- 2. analyte -> HGNC gene symbol (one representative symbol each) -------
gene_map <- c(
  "EGF"="EGF","FGF-2"="FGF2","PDGF-AA"="PDGFA","PDGF-AB/BB"="PDGFB","TGFa"="TGFA","VEGF-A"="VEGFA",
  "MMP-2"="MMP2","MMP-9"="MMP9",
  "Eotaxin"="CCL11","Fractalkine"="CX3CL1","GROa"="CXCL1","IL-8"="CXCL8","IP-10"="CXCL10",
  "MCP-1"="CCL2","MCP-3"="CCL7","MDC"="CCL22","MIG"="CXCL9","MIP-1a"="CCL3","MIP-1b"="CCL4",
  "IFNa2"="IFNA2","IFNy"="IFNG","IL-1a"="IL1A","IL-1b"="IL1B","IL-2"="IL2","IL-3"="IL3","IL-6"="IL6",
  "IL-12p40"="IL12B","IL-12p70"="IL12A","IL-15"="IL15","IL-17A"="IL17A","IL-17E/IL-25"="IL25",
  "IL-17F"="IL17F","IL-18"="IL18","TNFa"="TNF","TNFb"="LTA",
  "IL-1RA"="IL1RN","IL-4"="IL4","IL-5"="IL5","IL-9"="IL9","IL-10"="IL10","IL-13"="IL13",
  "IL-22"="IL22","IL-27"="IL27",
  "sCD40L"="CD40LG","FLT-3L"="FLT3LG","G-CSF"="CSF3","GM-CSF"="CSF2","IL-7"="IL7","M-CSF"="CSF1")

# ---- 3. derive the 'top' set: above LLoQ in every patient ----------------------
n_pat <- length(unique(df$patient))
agg <- aggregate(status ~ analyte + category, data = df,
                 FUN = function(s) sum(s == "QUANT"))
names(agg)[names(agg) == "status"] <- "n_quant"
agg$n_pat <- n_pat
top <- agg[agg$n_quant == n_pat, ]
top$gene <- gene_map[top$analyte]
if (any(is.na(top$gene)))
  stop("Unmapped analyte(s): ", paste(top$analyte[is.na(top$gene)], collapse = ", "))
top <- top[order(top$analyte), c("analyte","gene","category","n_quant","n_pat")]
write.csv(top, out_top, row.names = FALSE)
genes <- unique(top$gene)
cat(sprintf("Top set (QUANT in all %d patients): %d analytes\n", n_pat, nrow(top)))
cat(paste(genes, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")

# ---- 4. load Hallmark sets and count genes per set ------------------------
# Handle both new (collection=) and old (category=) msigdbr argument names.
hs <- tryCatch(msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "H"),
               error = function(e) msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "H"))
sym_col <- if ("gene_symbol" %in% names(hs)) "gene_symbol" else "human_gene_symbol"
sets <- split(hs[[sym_col]], hs$gs_name)
sets <- lapply(sets, unique)

# ---- 5. build ranked table with the ratio column --------------------------
n_genes <- vapply(sets, function(g) length(intersect(g, genes)), integer(1))
size    <- vapply(sets, length, integer(1))
keep    <- n_genes >= 1

out <- data.frame(
  hallmark = names(sets)[keep],
  n_genes  = n_genes[keep],
  size     = size[keep],
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
out$ratio <- round(out$n_genes / out$size, 4)
# readable label: drop the HALLMARK_ prefix, underscores -> spaces
out$label <- tools::toTitleCase(tolower(gsub("_", " ", sub("^HALLMARK_", "", out$hallmark))))

# primary ranking = raw count; ties broken by specificity ratio
out <- out[order(-out$n_genes, -out$ratio), ]
rownames(out) <- NULL

not_found <- setdiff(genes, unique(unlist(sets)))
cat(sprintf("Genes submitted: %d   not in any Hallmark set: %s\n",
            length(genes),
            if (length(not_found)) paste(not_found, collapse = ", ") else "0"))
cat(sprintf("Hallmark sets containing >=1 top gene: %d of 50\n\n", nrow(out)))

cat("=== Hallmark sets by number of top-expressed genes ===\n")
print(head(out[, c("n_genes","size","ratio","label")], 25), row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(out[, c("hallmark","label","n_genes","size","ratio")], out_pw, row.names = FALSE)

# ---- 6. figure: top 10 Hallmark sets by specificity ratio -----------------
# Bar length = ratio; text prints ratio and the raw count (n / size); count is
# also encoded by fill colour. Hallmark sets are curated and comparably sized,
# so no minimum-size floor is needed here.
top10 <- head(out[order(-out$ratio, -out$n_genes), ], 10)
wrap  <- function(x, w = 34) sapply(x, function(s) paste(strwrap(s, w), collapse = "\n"))
top10$label_y <- factor(wrap(top10$label),
                        levels = rev(wrap(top10$label)))   # keep rank order
top10$bar_lab <- sprintf("(%d/%d)", top10$n_genes, top10$size)

p <- ggplot(top10, aes(x = ratio, y = label_y, fill = n_genes)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72) +
  geom_text(aes(label = bar_lab), hjust = -0.05, size = 3.2) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#FBCEB1", high = "#EC5800", name = "cytokines\nin set") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.30))) +
  labs(title = "cSDH top-expressed cytokines: MSigDB Hallmark classification",
       subtitle = sprintf("Top 10 Hallmark sets by specificity ratio (n genes / set size); %d/%d-QUANT analytes",
                          n_pat, n_pat),
       x = "Cytokine ratio (cytokines in set/total set size)", y = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black", face = "bold"))   # cytokine labels)

ggsave(paste0(out_fig, ".png"), p, width = 9.5, height = 5.5, dpi = 300)
ggsave(paste0(out_fig, ".pdf"), p, width = 9.5, height = 5.5)

cat(sprintf("\nWritten: %s  (full ranked table)\n         %s  (top set + gene map)\n         %s.png / .pdf  (figure)\n",
            out_pw, out_top, out_fig))
p
```
